fields.description: Stable identifier shared with this Medusa backend. It travels in every envelope, names the site in logs, and must not change once records are correlated. Lower-case, no spaces.
fields.label: Site ID

fields.description: Human label for the Desk. Safe to change at any time.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: Turn a site off to stop sending to it without losing its configuration or its correlated records. Failure of one site never affects another.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Base URL of this Medusa backend, no trailing slash. e.g. https://store.example.com
fields.label: Medusa URL

fields.description: Path on that backend which receives our events.
fields.label: Inbound Path

fields.description: Seconds to wait for this site before giving up. Blank uses the global setting.
fields.label: Request Timeout (seconds)

fields.description: Uncheck only for a self-signed staging certificate.
fields.label: Verify SSL
Shared Secrets
fields.description: One pair per site, so a leak at one store cannot be used against another. Rotate one side, then the other; the brief mismatch shows as 401s that the retry sweep recovers.
This site signs requests TO us with this secret. Must match its plugin's webhook_secret. The signature is also how an inbound request is attributed to a site, so it cannot be spoofed by a header.
fields.label: Inbound Secret (Medusa → here)

fields.description: We sign requests TO this site with this secret. Must match its plugin's frappe_to_medusa_secret.
fields.label: Outbound Secret (here → Medusa)
Behaviour
fields.description: Which handler pack serves this store. The catalogue DocType is a global setting, not a per-store one.
Domain handler pack serving this site, when it needs one beyond the generic mapping engine. Blank uses the packs configured for the whole site in site_config.json.
fields.label: Handler Pack

fields.description: Customers who arrive from this store without an account manager are given this user. It is only used when that user exists here, and it never overrides one that arrived. Leave empty if your Customer form does not ask for one.
fields.label: Default Account Manager

fields.description: Last time this site accepted something from us.
fields.label: Last Seen At
What This Store Draws On
fields.description: Stock and prices are per store. Two stores can draw on the same warehouse under different stock-location ids. Leave both empty to keep the single warehouse and single selling price list named in Medusync Settings.

fields.label: Warehouses
fields.description: ERPNext warehouses whose sellable stock reaches this store, and the Stock Location each one feeds.

fields.label: Price Lists
fields.description: Price lists this store sees and which way each one travels. Customer-specific prices belong to Medusa customer groups and price lists.

fields.label: Consecutive Failures
fields.description: Reset to zero the moment this store answers.

fields.label: Stopped Trying At
fields.description: Set when the failures above reached the threshold. While this is set, deliveries to this store are skipped rather than attempted, and one is let through per minute to find out whether it has come back. One success clears it. Other stores are unaffected.

fields.label: Stop Trying After
fields.description: Consecutive failures before this store is left alone. Ten is about a deploy's worth of downtime at the retry backoff, so a rolling restart does not trip it and a real outage does.

fields.label: Orders and Invoices
fields.description: What a store order becomes here, who numbers its invoice, and whether the customer can download it from the store.

fields.label: A Store Order Becomes
fields.options:
Sales Order
Sales Invoice
Sales Order and Sales Invoice
fields.description: Sales Invoice skips the order entirely and bills straight from what the store sent: lines, taxes, shipping and payment.

fields.label: Submit What Arrives
fields.description: Leave unticked to receive drafts and submit them after review.

fields.label: Record Store Payments
fields.description: Book a Payment Entry for money the store captured, against the invoice (or as an advance on the order).

fields.label: Mode of Payment
fields.description: Its default account for the company receives the money.

fields.label: Invoice Numbering
fields.options:
ERPNext numbers the invoice (company series)
ERPNext numbers the invoice (separate store series)
The store numbers the invoice
fields.description: Company series: invoices share the company's own Sales Invoice series. Separate store series: ERPNext still numbers them, but under a series of their own. Either way ERPNext generates the invoice and pushes the PDF to the store. The store numbers the invoice: the store owns the series, ERPNext books what it sends and pushes nothing back.

fields.label: Separate Invoice Series
fields.depends_on: eval:doc.invoice_numbering=='ERPNext numbers the invoice (separate store series)'
fields.mandatory_depends_on: eval:doc.invoice_numbering=='ERPNext numbers the invoice (separate store series)'
fields.description: The naming series ERPNext gives this store's invoices, e.g. STORE-INV-.YYYY.-  Added to the Sales Invoice series list if it is not there yet.

fields.label: Store Invoice Prefix
fields.description: The store numbers its invoices as this prefix and a running number, e.g. STR-00042. Change it to suit the store. Must not collide with an ERPNext naming series; ERPNext will refuse to create an invoice under it.

fields.depends_on: eval:['ERPNext numbers the invoice (company series)','ERPNext numbers the invoice (separate store series)'].includes(doc.invoice_numbering)
fields.label: Send Invoice PDF to the Store
fields.description: On submit, the store fetches the PDF and keeps it privately; only the customer who placed the order can download it. Never sent when the store numbers its own invoices.

fields.depends_on: eval:(['ERPNext numbers the invoice (company series)','ERPNext numbers the invoice (separate store series)'].includes(doc.invoice_numbering)) && doc.send_invoice_to_store
fields.label: Invoice Print Format
fields.description: Blank uses the Sales Invoice default.
